title: null vs undefined in plain English
why_it_matters: Mixing them up makes data bugs harder to hunt down.
explanation: undefined means no value was ever set, like a missing property or an argument nobody passed. null means empty on purpose, a value you chose to set. Both are falsy, but they tell different stories when you're hunting a bug.
try_it: Declare a variable without a value and log it. Then set it to null on purpose.
